verification_scope: Read-only review plus independent checksum and JUnit parsing. The 19 tests were executed by the implementing provider agent; this review did not repeat them or launch a molecular-dynamics child.
conclusion: The three concrete exception/receipt findings were fixed before scheduler source freeze. No remaining code blocker was found in the reviewed exclusion and ordinary-exception drain paths. Actual migration still requires independently observed normal old-native exits and retired legacy dispatchers.

resolved_findings.finding: Journaling after a successful Popen could raise before reaching child.wait.
resolved_findings.resolution: An invocation ExitStack registers child.wait immediately after Popen; cleanup waits before closing the child log and preserves inherited leases. An injected post-spawn logging failure test requires the failure latch to exist before the wait.

resolved_findings.finding: A locked pre-dispatch validation exception could release launch_lock before setting stopped.
resolved_findings.resolution: The exception handler calls latch while it still owns launch_lock. A regression rejects every Popen after injected source validation failure.

resolved_findings.finding: An empty or duplicate old-dispatcher list could pass the migration receipt.
resolved_findings.resolution: The receipt requires exactly one odd and one even entry, four distinct positive dispatcher/native PIDs, normal native exit codes, and all seed prefixes; malformed-receipt tests cover missing/duplicate queues.

exclusion_review: Every native child inherits coordinator, both legacy queue, and own-seed flock descriptors through pass_fds.
Locks are released only by closing file descriptions; no explicit LOCK_UN accidentally releases a child-held lease.
A durable FAILURE.json prevents later invocations; in-flight children are allowed to finish, not terminated or replaced.
Two or four executor workers process the same four fixed queues with all seed leases held; thread-count fallback changes orchestration only.
Existing chunk prefixes, source identity, initial state and per-seed configuration are rechecked before new native calls.
runtime_handoff_status: Not certified by this code review. At the provider handoff, one old native child had exited normally; the other was still running. Do not use this review as a substitute for the final migration receipt.
